title: semgate-decision/1
description: semgate's answer to one semgate-check/1 request. Run the tool only on decision allow.

decision.description: allow: run it. ask: do not run; use approval_id when present. Privacy reviews require resolving the privacy check and have no approval_id. deny: do not run it; give reason to the model.

reason.description: Why, for the human and the model. Secret values and the home folder are masked.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable code: the judge's code (e.g. hard_deny, injection_deny, human_gate:credentials_secrets, aligned_readonly_allow), or human_approved_once, human_denied, semgate_timeout, semgate_failure.

stage.description: The judge's stage: hard_rules, human_gate, semantic, trusted, human_approved, ... Empty when semgate failed before judging.

approval_id.description: With ask: the id the human side passes to approve(). With an allow or deny that came from a human answer: that approval.

timeout.description: Present when the deadline passed before a decision.
